author: David Bombal
description:
Microsoft Defender is built into Windows and provides important protection, but does that mean you don’t need anything else?

In this clip, we discuss how attackers may attempt to bypass security controls, manipulate Defender exclusions, and make a system appear protected even when certain files or locations are no longer being scanned.

Modern attacks are also becoming increasingly targeted and sophisticated. Simply avoiding obvious phishing emails isn’t always enough.

The real question isn’t just whether you have antivirus. It’s whether your security controls are actually working as expected.

Thank you to @Threatlocker for sponsoring this video and my trip to Black Hat USA.

title: Is Windows Defender Good Enough in 2026?
